name: WV Supply
old_description: WV Supply helps customers get work done profitably with responsive local support, dependable delivery, and access to the products and services that keep projects moving.
about:
WV Supply operates from its headquarters in Marietta, Ohio, and serves customers across West Virginia, Kentucky, and Ohio through eight branch locations. With over 90 years of experience in electrical distribution, the company has built a regional footprint that supports contractors, industrial operations, facilities, and project teams.

As a full-line electrical distributor, WV Supply stocks more than 20,000 products and represents over 160 manufacturers across core categories that include builder’s products, conduit and fittings, electrical distribution and management, enclosures, hardware, lighting, tools, wire and cable, and wiring devices. Beyond inventory, the company provides a suite of field-focused services: routine and jobsite delivery, 24/7 emergency support, pre-staged deliveries organized by project phase or area, on-site trailer service for immediate crew access, vendor-managed inventory programs, and specialized wire services such as custom cutting, pulling heads, paralleling, color phasing, and staged identification for wire ranging from 20 AWG to 750 MCM. Account tools include credit services, BillPay, ePOD, job-account structures, tax-exempt processing, and ANSI X12 EDI integration.

The customer base spans commercial, institutional, and general construction projects, as well as industrial maintenance and facility operations. Electrical contractors, plant managers, and project superintendents rely on the distributor for product availability, rapid response, and logistical support that keeps work on schedule.

WV Supply’s stated mission is to help customers get their work done profitably. The company emphasizes three commitments — making it happen when conditions change, acting immediately through local teams, and delivering when it matters — guided by values of integrity, excellence, and customer value.
